## Activity

During November 2018, East City Eye Clinic recorded 202 captures. This represents the activity completed by the clinic team during the month. The recorded capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. No further activity figures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 202 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.5. This result indicates that almost all captures were available for grading. The ungradable capture remains included in the overall activity total and is reported separately to distinguish image-quality outcomes from grading outcomes.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. The clinic’s operational position was therefore recorded without any additional equipment issues noted in the report.

## Grading

A total of 32 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. This provides the reported summary of grading activity for November 2018. The referable results and median lag should be considered alongside the total capture activity and the single ungradable capture when reviewing site performance.
